verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no in-product AI-generated insights or suggestions. GlitchTip's AI story is a built-in MCP server that lets external AI assistants pull error, performance and log data into the user's own tools. That is an adjacent capability, not AI insights delivered inside the product. The N+1 detection tool is a pattern-detection query exposed through MCP, not AI-generated analysis.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
